paymentShouldFail.description: demo-only failure-injection toggle to exercise saga compensation; production services MUST NOT expose debug hooks on the business wire — drive failures from real downstream responses

idempotencyKey.description: client-supplied idempotency key; the same key returns the same order without re-running the saga (Temporal workflow-id / DTM GID model). Must contain only ASCII letters, digits, and the separators ._:/- (matching idutil.IsSafeID) so that the derived orderID ('ord-'+key) is a valid idutil.SafeID
